summary: Red Metal Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K, attaching a press release announcing the filing of Form 15F with the SEC to terminate its registration under Section 12(g) and reporting obligations under Sections 13(a) and 15(d) of the Exchange Act. The company qualifies via the average daily trading volume condition (1,376 US shares vs 138,486 worldwide, or 0.99%) under Rule 12h-6(a)(4)(i). Reporting is suspended immediately upon filing; termination effective 90 days after filing unless SEC objects. Shares continue trading on CSE, Frankfurt, and OTC Pink. What to watch: SEC non-objection and continued availability of home-country disclosure via SEDAR+.
